messages:
Nora (CS Ops): Heads-up: renewal playbooks missed a bunch of accounts last quarter. Looks like the usage-anomaly detector writes a usage_event.id that isn't captured in CRM.external_ids, so playbook matching misses those accounts. Can we add a mapping sync and a lightweight playbook hook?

Diego: +1. Which accounts are highest priority?

Nora (CS Ops): Focus on accounts in renewal window (90d) and accounts with enablement_recent=true. Backfill only for usage_event.last_seen > '2026-01-01' to avoid old noise.

Olivia: Suggested flow: 1) run a staging backfill that writes usage_event_ids into accounts.external_ids_tmp, 2) diff playbook matches, 3) swap after validation. Keep a dry-run mode. SQL sketch: 
```
UPDATE crm.accounts a
SET external_ids_tmp = array_distinct(coalesce(a.external_ids_tmp, '{}') || u.event_id)
FROM usage_events u
WHERE u.account_id = a.id AND u.last_seen > '2026-01-01' AND a.renewal_window = true;
```

Diego: Matcher change too: prefer external_ids over customer_email when both exist to avoid creating new ghost accounts for usage-only signals. I can add a config flag and a regression test.

Nora (CS Ops): Webhook payload for playbook trigger should be minimal and stable: 
```
account_id: string
external_ids: [string]
event_type: string
usage_delta_pct: number
event_ts: ISO8601
source: "usage-detector"
```
Include optional "severity":"high|medium|low" when delta > 50%.

Olivia: We'll debounce duplicates in the ingestion lambda (15m window) and include an idempotency key. Rate-limit staging writes to 600/min during backfill.

Diego: Plan: staging backfill tonight (dry-run), deploy matcher config to staging, run playbook smoke tests, then prod backfill + deploy in a maintenance window. I'll own matcher + tests.

deploy-bot: Deployment window requested 2026-09-07 01:30 UTC by Diego. :gear:

Nora (CS Ops): I'll validate pre/post counts and add a dashboard card: "Renewal playbook matches from usage events" with weekly trend. Please post sample rows (10) and the diff after staging run. :eyes:

qa-bot: Reminder: include a test case where email is shared across two accounts but external_id maps only to the correct account.

Olivia: Running staging dry-run now, will post counts and 10 samples in this thread when finished.

Nora (CS Ops): Thanks team — after staging looks good, open a prod ticket and tag owners for the swap. :thumbsup:
